newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CST.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to off 0.150 cent. Boxed beef and cash cattle markets lower but look to Friday report.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady to off 0.100. Easier live cattle and higher corn calls, but may hold on inventory expectations.
LEAN HOGS - Steady to off 0.200. Lower cash hog calls and weak pork products but short covering may develop.
PORK BELLIES - Steady to off 0.200. Larger kill ideas and steady to weaker product but looks oversold and slaughter has been running less than expected.
